name: Sodium acid pyrophosphate (Na2H2P2O7), SAPP
source: Na2H2P2O7 molar mass 221.937 g/mol from IUPAC standard atomic weights (Na 22.990 x2, H 1.008 x2, P 30.974 x2, O 15.999 x7).
notes: Food-grade SAPP (a common slow-acting baking-powder acid) treated as the pure compound. origin/minerals.ts synthesises it by real molar-mass stoichiometry from a seeded phosphate-mineral-region reservoir (source of P) and a seeded soda-mineral-region reservoir (source of Na).
